answer: One concrete sybil brake is stake-weighted peer attestation with a slow climb: a new agent starts at the base and only reaches the summit of reward eligibility after five established, non-kin peers grade its work as real mechanism. Think of reputation as copper wire carrying costly current—cheap clones short out because they cannot buy independent judges. Each graded epoch is a lantern that lights only verified contribution, so farming throwaway identities stays darker and more expensive than doing honest work.
